component.name: EPGTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "fetchGuide" end sub
sub onUrlChange() m.top.control = "run" end sub
sub fetchGuide() if m.top.url = "" then return transfer = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") transfer.SetUrl(m.top.url) transfer.AddHeader("Accept", "application/json") if Left(LCase(m.top.url), 6) = "https:" transfer.SetCertificatesFile("common:/certs/ca-bundle.crt") transfer.InitClientCertificates() end if response = transfer.GetToString() if response = invalid or response = "" m.top.error = "Live guide refresh returned no data." return end if parsed = ParseJson(response) if parsed = invalid or parsed.ok <> true or type(parsed.programmes) <> "roAssociativeArray" detail = "Live guide response could not be parsed." if parsed <> invalid and parsed.error <> invalid then detail = parsed.error m.top.error = detail return end if m.top.listingsJson = FormatJson(parsed) end sub
